import random, json, sys
from fractions import Fraction

def gen(seed=1):
    rnd=random.Random(seed)
    nodes=['n%d'%i for i in range(12)]
    edges=[]
    # a "trunk" edge used by everything, plus parallel edges
    edges.append({'id':'trunk','source':'n0','target':'n1','capacity':1000000})
    for i in range(31):
        a=rnd.randrange(12); b=rnd.randrange(12)
        while b==a: b=rnd.randrange(12)
        edges.append({'id':'e%d'%i,'source':'n%d'%a,'target':'n%d'%b,'capacity':1000000})
    # each commodity: source n2.., target ..., routes: trunk-ish path + alternatives
    commodities=[]
    for i in range(12):
        src='n%d'%(2+i%10); tgt='n1'
        # route 1: src -> n0 -> n1 via trunk ; need an edge src->n0
        # create helper edges
        pass
    # build helper edges src->n0 for each source
    edges=[e for e in edges if e['id']!='trunk']
    helper={}
    for i in range(10):
        eid='h%d'%i
        edges.append({'id':eid,'source':'n%d'%(2+i%10),'target':'n0','capacity':1000000})
        helper['n%d'%(2+i%10)]=eid
    edges.append({'id':'trunk','source':'n0','target':'n1','capacity':1000000})
    for i in range(12):
        src='n%d'%(2+i%10)
        W=rnd.choice([5,7,8])
        routes=[{'edges':[helper[src],'trunk'],'weight':W}]
        # an alternative route with the same weight split
        if rnd.random()<0.5:
            routes.append({'edges':[helper[src],'trunk'],'weight':W})
        commodities.append({'id':'c%d'%i,'source':src,'target':'n1','routes':routes})
    domains=['d%d'%i for i in range(14)]
    snapshots=[]
    for si in range(4):
        bounds=[[0,10000] for _ in commodities]
        obs=[]
        # pin the trunk load exactly
        obs.append({'id':'t0','metric':'link','target':'trunk','lower':0,'upper':1000000,'domain':None})
        for i in range(63):
            kind=rnd.choice(['demand','link','ingress','egress'])
            if kind=='demand': t=rnd.choice(commodities)['id']
            elif kind=='link': t=rnd.choice(edges)['id']
            else: t=rnd.choice(nodes)
            obs.append({'id':'o%d'%i,'metric':kind,'target':t,'lower':rnd.randint(0,1000),'upper':rnd.randint(1000,100000),'domain':rnd.choice(domains+[None])})
        snapshots.append({'id':'s%d'%si,'bounds':bounds,'controller':[0]*12,'tolerance':0,'observations':obs})
    return {'id':'hard','version':1,'nodes':nodes,'edges':edges,'commodities':commodities,
            'domains':domains,'max_faults':3,'snapshots':snapshots}

if __name__=='__main__':
    print(json.dumps(gen(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 1)))
PYEOF
